text: Revise the firstmate study page at https://doodla.github.io/athena/: (1) define 'captain' and 'yolo' where they first appear in 'Start here'; (2) add a glossary entry for 'home' (firstmate home); (3) use two different terms for firstmate's deciding agent and for the worker agents, and say which one 'decided by agent' means; (4) explain why the yolo merge t10 is drawn ready → ready when t4 says a merge leads to done, or fix the diagram; (5) give each design-choice card (ra1–ra6) a short topic title; (6) relabel or explain the 'terminal-success' tag on reopened; (7) explain the study identifier in the lede, or remove it. Keep the opening and the next steps as they are; the rating praised both.
